A verdict-only diff reads GREEN over that; the `fp=` comparison is what makes this a measurement rather than a coincidence. ⛔ **AND THE REF-PROVENANCE OBJECTION IS ANSWERED RATHER THAN IGNORED**: this master's refs are a SELF-PIN (this file has said so since 09-03), which would normally cap what a green cell proves — but it does NOT cap this one, because an A/B between two arms on one tree compares the two OUTPUTS to each other, and the fingerprint arm compares raw bytes rather than verdicts, so the ref's provenance cancels out of the conclusion entirely. ⭐ **THE THIRD ARM, WHICH IS ORACLE-GRADED AND NOT A SELF-PIN:** all **17 raku benchmark+demo programs run at both arenas, 17 of 17 IDENTICAL** (verdict, output fingerprint and rc), against refs I PROVED oracle-correct the same sitting — **17 of 17 agree byte-for-byte with rakudo-local 2026.05**. ⛔ **AND THE COMPLETENESS FACT THAT FELL OUT OF PROVING THEM: only 5 of those 17 benchmarks PASS.** Twelve do not (eleven `rc=1` compile refusals, `fp=d41d8cd9` = empty output; one wrong answer at rc=0, `pi-sequential-iteration`) — so **twelve of seventeen raku benchmarks would have been TIMED on an answer that is not the right answer**, which is Lon's REF order (*"how would you know what you are measuring unless the output is correct"*) landing on this lane with a number. ⭐ **FOURTH ARM, the ceo's own snobol4 probe shape re-run in raku:** the three raku GC witnesses at `SCRIP_HEAP_MB=1` across `SCRIP_GC_STRESS` 0,1,2,3,4,5,8,16 in BOTH modes — **48 gradings, 0 mismatches**, where the snobol4 witness reads 4 of 7 stress points wrong. ⛔ **WHAT THIS DOES NOT SAY:** it does not say the collector is correct, and it does not clear any other lane — it says NO RAKU ANSWER IN THESE FOUR POPULATIONS MOVES WHEN THE COLLECTOR RUNS CONSTANTLY. The raku slot-kind census beside it reads **graded=922 no_layout=7 (declared=2 defect=5), unkinded=0 holes=0** (was 9/graded=918 at `621c08866`; `benchmark_rc-man-or-boy-test` and `benchmark_point_class_add2` gained layouts on the `:=` bind landing). The five defects are rowed elsewhere and are front-end parse refusals, not collector holes — measured, not assumed: every no_layout entry is ALSO red on this board, so the set is a SUBSET of the master's own reds.

Same tree `5418432bb`, same corpus `8486bb1e2`, SAME BINARY as both green arms (`BINARY_AT_START 84d80bfb4f63 53d26946653b`), one knob added: `SCRIP_GC_STRESS=16`. **m3 853 → 817 · m4 853 → 824 · 65 gradings LOST, ZERO gained, 36 distinct programs, every one rc=0 with no diagnostic and a plausible wrong answer.** ⛔ **RAKU IS NOT CLEAN AT THE TINY ARENA AND MODE TENET CONDITION 1 IS NOT MET IN THIS LANE** — completeness does not open here, and this cell says so rather than letting a 853/929 headline imply otherwise. **TWO FAMILIES, both MATCHING at stress 0 and wrong from stress 1:** GRAMMAR PARSE prints EMPTY where the ref is a match object (`say_29`..`say_50`, `say_replace_6`, `token_1`, `token_regex_1`, `token_say_1`..`4`; both modes) · BLOCK METHOD CALL prints `()` where the ref is `(A B)` (`ladder__rung19_block_methcall` + 3 siblings, `ladder__rung20_paren_group_*` × 3; m3 only). Rowed rank 0 as `raku-gc-thirty-six-programs-return-a-silently-wrong-answer-under-forced-collection-and-the-arena-ab-reads-green-over-all-of-them`, with a DONE-WHEN proven RED today and a PREMISE-WHEN proven in three directions. ⭐ **THE ABLATION, so nobody re-derives the suspect set:** `("a","b").join("-")` is CORRECT at stress 1 while `.map({block})` and `G.parse` on the same shapes are wrong — so it is not the list, not the literal and not methods in general, but the only two raku runtime entries that RE-ENTER EMITTED CODE THROUGH A SAVED CALL and hold collected-heap state across it (`rk_iter_open`/`rk_iter_step`, `rk_gram_enter_box`). `join` never leaves the runtime and survives. ⛔⭐⭐ **THE INSTRUMENT LESSON, AND IT IS WHY THIS PARAGRAPH IS LONGER THAN THE NUMBER:** the superseded reading was 1858 (program,mode) gradings at ZERO verdict divergences PLUS a fingerprint diff over every non-passing grading at zero PLUS 17 of 17 benchmarks identical — all on one tree with one binary, none of it careless, and **green over all 36 of these programs.** The reason is one sentence, measured by hq_snobol4 and relayed by hq_prolog: **the class is arena-INSENSITIVE and stress-SENSITIVE.** `SCRIP_GC_STRESS` unset means ZERO forced collections (`gc_heap.c:245` sets collect-pending every N allocations), so a 1 MB window collects more often than nearly-never — which on programs this size is still nearly-never. ⭐⭐ **A CONTROL ARM ONLY CONTROLS THE AXIS YOU VARIED. State which axis the defect is expected to move along BEFORE trusting an A/B; if it is not the axis you varied, your zero is a measured property of the wrong experiment** — and a suite table that names the arena then makes that zero read as coverage, which is worse than silence. ⭐ WHAT SURVIVES THE SUPERSESSION, unchanged and still useful: the fingerprint method itself (identical VERDICTS hide a differently-wrong answer, `FAIL == FAIL`, so 136 FAIL rows per arm were dark to a verdict diff), the slot-kind census **graded=922 no_layout=7 (declared=2 defect=5) unkinded=0 holes=0**, and Lon's REF order in this lane: **0 of 17 refless and 17 of 17 refs agreeing byte-for-byte with rakudo-local 2026.05, of which only 5 PASS** — twelve of seventeen raku benchmarks would have been TIMED on an answer that is not the right answer. ⛔⭐ **WHICH FRACTION THE SUITE ROW MEANS IS A JUDGEMENT AND I AM MAKING IT IN THE OPEN, because `util_score_row.py` REFUSED to guess and was right to.** The suite row stays **853/929** — the reading at the SHIPPED configuration (`SCRIP_HEAP_MB` unset, `SCRIP_GC_STRESS` unset), re-measured on THIS tree today. **817/929 is a PROBE reading under a non-default knob and must not become the suite's headline**, because "the raku master is 817/929" is false of the compiler as shipped. ⛔ THIS IS NOT A DENOMINATOR NARROWED TO MAKE A CELL READ BETTER (CEO-993): the red is published in full above, named program by program, rowed rank 0, and reported to the ceo as a reversal of my own earlier receipt — what is being kept out of the suite row is a CONFIGURATION, not a defect. The 36 programs are counted against this lane in the row, not hidden in the fraction. ⛔⭐⭐ **AND THE STRESS ARM'S OWN NUMBER IS A LOWER BOUND, NOT A POPULATION — I am relabelling my own finding rather than letting 36 stand.** Measured after the board, same binary, same arena, same stress value: **the SAME FILE, same inode, prints the right answer invoked as `p/xxxxxxxx.raku` and a silently wrong one invoked as `./p/xxxxxxxx.raku`.** Fifteen characters versus seventeen; a clean threshold at 16 bytes across path lengths 12–22, deterministic over five repeats. The argv string is allocated and the stress plant counts ALLOCATIONS, so the pathname decides which allocation the forced collection lands on. **The defect is in the program; its VISIBILITY is in the allocation history, and the allocation history includes things that are not the program.** Consequences, both measured: a stress NAME SET is contingent on the runner's temp paths — `ab2.raku` (9 chars) reads CORRECT at stress 8 and 16 while the BYTE-IDENTICAL suite entry `ladder__rung19_block_methcall.raku` (33 chars) reads WRONG at both, and for an hour I read those as two different defects; and **"go above 5" is a DIFFERENT blind spot, not a safer one** — the map family's window is stress 1–6 and it is INVISIBLE at ≥8, while the grammar family is wrong at EVERY point above 0. ✅ **NOT A REGRESSION, AND I PREDICTED WRONG:** `rk_iter_open` landed today at 13:01 (`a786bb164`, mine), so I expected the map family to be my own regression; the pre-today tree `2ce1d8a74` was built in a scratch worktree and **both families fail there identically, band for band.** ⛔ **AND A DEFECT IN MY OWN BAND SCRIPT, one hour after I preached the lesson:** it compared an EMPTY output against a MISSING ref file (`"" = ""`) and printed ok six times, reporting the grammar family clean when it is wrong everywhere above stress 0. hq_snobol4's warning that `d41d8cd9` is the md5 of the EMPTY STRING, hq_prolog's absent-companion class and my own name-them-never-count-them line all landed on one throwaway script of mine inside an hour. ⭐ **An instrument that cannot distinguish EMPTY from MATCHED is not a weaker instrument — it is one that reports success on nothing.**
